description: Three rounds of two distance-3 bit-flip repetition codes in lockstep, one a Z memory and one an X memory (10 ions), then the data read out, each in its own basis. It corrects bit flips (distance 3) and no phase flips (distance 1 in the X memory): what a code without phase protection gives. Ranked with every Goal 1 code by the logical error rate per round per logical qubit under qccd-noise@2, with Helios-class physics in which every number is cited.
